ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram shown, which is the producer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture is a food web, with “Meadow Grasses” labeled at the bottom, Deer, Rabbit, and Vole above it, and Coyote and Hawk higher up. Arrows point from Meadow Grasses to Deer, Rabbit, and Vole, indicating that the grasses are eaten by these animals. Reasoning: Producers are organisms that can make their own food, usually plants, and are located at the base position of the food web. In the picture, the one located at the bottom and serving as the food source is Meadow Grasses, so the producer is Meadow Grasses.
